batch.label: samling
batch.prompt: Use the reference only for drawing style. Create one isolated illustration: One adult preschool teacher and three preschool children seated facing each other in an open circle. Their common attention is directed into the circle. All four people are seated on the floor. Isolated figures without scenery, signs, books or writing. Warm contemporary children's book illustration, fine brown pencil lines, soft watercolor shading, natural proportions and muted sage, ochre and terracotta. Isolated on pure white without text, scenery or cast shadows. Show only the requested concept, with its essential identifying details large and readable. No decorative scene, no lettering or card border.
